arm.lists: ws_calib z >= 10.6 lists, own group excluded (part-2 Z on DPANN; part-3 Z on Spacedust)
arm.counting: genome groups (vl 'grp': n = 1 + supporting groups, E over groups)
arm.adaptive_bonds: every pair of genes within 8 positions on one contig (adjacency over distance d = 1..8, homolog pairs excluded by the round-0 exclusion rule extended to d <= 8) is tested at its own window: a list partner pair (p, q) supports the pair only if p and q lie within d positions of each other in the other genome; E per genome = min(1, 2 d c_x c_y / m), own term min(1, 2 d / m); Lambda over groups; bond if n >= 2 and Lambda >= tau
arm.kernel: copy of vl.py mark / pass_count / adjacency with a per-adjacency window; marks record the minimum distance from any list partner. Gate before use: in fixed-window mode at window 3 the copy must reproduce vl.pass_count's round-0 n, n_groups, E and E_groups exactly on the observed DPANN order; the d <= 3 part of the new exclusion masks must equal the stored masks
arm.exclusion_masks: softrec.exclusion mode 1, K1000 variant (identical sequence, or cosine >= max(.32, min(capcos))) over instances up to distance 8, observed order and 3 shuffles; DPANN capcos from vl.emb_lists (the stored zca10 kNN, group lineage), Spacedust capcos from the part-3 exact kNN
arm.tau: bond-level 1% rule on the adaptive procedure: smallest of {4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30} with mean shuffled bonds / observed bonds <= .01 (3 gene-order shuffles, softrec.null_order seeds 1000-1002)
arm.outputs: L1; L4b(theta) and L4b+(theta), theta in {.02, .05, .1, .2}, kNN cohesion (DPANN context_units kappa_var_knn50; Spacedust part-3 kappa_var_knn50); L4b node filter = part-2 family-free list test at the bond tau

selection_dpann_odd: among L1 / L4b(theta) / L4b+(theta): maximise [odd conditions met vs DH, odd ribosomal resolved, odd summed] (standing rule); recorded before any even number
dpann_even: selected output: the seven quantities; paired intervals vs token DH, part-2 Z (L4b+ .02), part-4 family WA (L4b .2), part-1 L4b (.1) and part-2 A (L4b .02) for the summed-excess cost; ribosomal resolved paired vs DH, part-2 Z and part-4 WA; CRISPR-Cas margin = d F1 CCT vs DH + .02
spacedust: primary = the DPANN-selected Z-WA output; other Z-WA outputs (L1; L4b and L4b+ at the selected theta) are DEVELOPMENT rows; comparisons as part 4 (part-1 L4b, part-1 L1, CC2, engine reference, native Spacedust) plus part-3 Z and part-4 WA L4b; coverage by region size; excess by region size; share of genes in loci; boundary precision
success_definition: one output: all seven DPANN bars with CRISPR-Cas d F1 >= -.01 (margin >= .01) AND Spacedust d excess vs the engine reference >= -.02 (MATCHES or BEATS)
